name: Microgrid wind available-power interface
summary: Receives the declared available contribution of the assigned wind generation resource.
description: Receives the declared available contribution of the assigned wind generation resource. Renewable-generation coordination connects variable resource availability, inverter operating limits and the microgrid power target. Available solar or wind power, an issued curtailment request and actual delivered power are different signals.

In a microgrid with solar generation, the controller can restrain inverter output when local load and storage cannot absorb the available power. The resource controller reports its own availability and accepted operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Wind resource availability” at the input and “Wind power capability” at the output. Turbine and plant constraints affect availability.

Resource forecasts and controller requests do not guarantee the delivered generation at every instant. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application.
